Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Frozen Assets]]: an FBI evidence photograph of part of the $90,000 in cash found in the freezer of United States Congressman William J. Jefferson during a search of his home, the bundles wrapped in aluminium foil beside frozen food. Wikimedia Commons notes that the pie-crust packaging appears to have been altered to a generic design.

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cash_in_freeze_Congressman_Jefferson_corruption_case.jpg Cash in freeze Congressman Jefferson corruption case.jpg], Wikimedia Commons, author Federal Bureau of Investigation (from fbi.gov, "A Look Back at the William J. Jefferson Corruption Case", 2013). Unchanged. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251012120333/https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cash_in_freeze_Congressman_Jefferson_corruption_case.jpg Internet Archive], 12 October 2025.
